text: Easily manage your monitoredlocations in the Places tab

summarization: The smartphone UI screen indicates that a location, San Francisco, California, has been added to a monitoring list. The screen suggests that users can easily manage their monitored locations in the "Places" tab. The UI features a visual of a smartphone displaying an "Emergency" app with two main tabs: "ALERTS" and "PLACES." The "PLACES" tab is highlighted, showing a location (Cranford, NJ) being tracked, with monitored hazards and people. At the bottom of the screen, there is a prominent red "FINISH" button for the user to complete the process.
